governing_sources.role: core domain model and structural validation

source_document.title: Large language model-assisted referral triage automation in a tertiary hospital
source_document.publication_status: Article in Press; unedited accepted manuscript
source_document.source_type: Primary research article; retrospective single-center LLM classification evaluation
source_document.study_setting: Samsung Medical Center, tertiary hospital, South Korea

source_consistency_notes.issue: The abstract reports 5.9% of referrals lacked sufficient information, whereas the Results section reports 6 of 104 discordant cases (5.8%).
source_consistency_notes.handling: The atom uses the denominator-backed Results value of 6/104 (5.8%); the discrepancy remains unresolved in the article-in-press source.

source_consistency_notes.issue: Figure 2 labels the 680-referral split as a validation set, while the text consistently describes it as a hold-out test set.
source_consistency_notes.handling: Atoms use the textual designation hold-out test set and retain the source terminology issue in this report.

source_consistency_notes.issue: The abstract describes incorporation of real-time clinician availability, while Methods state that a point-in-time roster snapshot was frozen for evaluation.
source_consistency_notes.handling: Method atoms represent the evaluated configuration as a frozen snapshot; dynamic roster updating is retained only as an author implementation claim.

extraction_limitations: The uploaded PDF is an unedited Article in Press manuscript and may change before final publication.
Supplementary Figure S1 and Supplementary Tables S1-S5 were cited but were not present in the uploaded 29-page PDF; no supplement-only atoms were extracted.
Underlying referral-level data and implementation code were unavailable, so atom verification was limited to the reported aggregate text, tables, and figures.
The extraction targets load-bearing independently reviewable assertions and is not an exhaustive atomization of every background or descriptive sentence.
All atoms remain review_status=needs_review because no human reviewer verified the extraction.
